description: Returns one unit with everything needed to port it: source text, symbols, the engine APIs it uses with their mapped equivalents and line numbers (apiHints), conventions, target path and naming rules, dependencies with the symbols of their already-ported targets, and a checklist. Marks it in_progress.

full.description: Repeat the conventions and checklist even after the first finished unit (they are shortened after that).

planId.description: Port plan id from port_plan (port_status lists them).

unit.description: Unit id (u001…), or its source/target path. Omit for the next unit in dependency order.

name: port_unit
title: Get the next unit to port
